author: Microsoft
description:
If you still think AI is just a tool, you’re already behind.

In this WorkLab podcast clip, Allie K. Miller, AI leader, investor, and former Global Head of Machine Learning at AWS, explains why treating AI like traditional software limits its impact.

Real transformation happens when organizations rethink business models, processes, and entire operating structures—not just productivity gains.

Watch the full episode: https://youtu.be/cazd1z4Eseo
title: What actually makes someone succeed in the age of AI?

author: Microsoft
description:
What does it take to move the needle with AI? Top AI voice Allie K. Miller joins WorkLab to share why some of the biggest advances aren’t coming from the usual places—or people. She explains how organizations can unlock new value by giving unconventional thinkers room to experiment, why speed and iteration matter more than perfection, and how leaders can turn edge ideas into real business impact. Plus: how agentic workflows, voice interfaces, and cross-disciplinary teams are reshaping the future of work.
